description: Medical dictation transcription, whisper-large-v3-turbo on a GPU server (docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 5.2). Type 1: fixed price, served first.

energy_kwh_per_work_unit.source: derived: 1 kWh per 1 kW server-hour / (469.9 audio hours per server-hour x 60 min/h) = 3.5469e-5 kWh per audio minute; TranscriptionAudioHoursPerServerHour in config/hardware/gpu-inference-l4.json (whisper-large-v3-turbo on L4, data/raw/market/hardware.csv hw-perf-e2e-l4-whisper-turbo-b4, low: vendor blog via snippet); same hardware profile as the LLM throughput and the full-cost step; checked by the fleet test suite

size.source: median: Bax et al. 2011, Health Econ Rev 1:8: median dictation length 6.5 min per letter, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3402968/ (abstract, accessed 2026-11-21), as config/job-scenarios/transcription-basel.json; sigma 0 (every dictation 6.5 min): TODO(source) spread of dictation length not sourced

batch_size.source: scenario value: one dictation per job (docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 5.2: batch size configurable, default 1); not sourced

max_chunks.source: scenario value: one dictation is not split (docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 5.2: splitting per dictation)

min_chunk_work_units.source: one dictation = the median dictation length (Bax et al. 2011, as size); splitting is per dictation (docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 5.2)

start_overhead_s.source: TODO(source): model-load time per chunk start (the T-02 runner reloads a 3 GB model per chunk) not sourced; 0 = not modelled

min_load.source: TODO(source): lowest sustainable GPU load not sourced; 0 = continuous load as Core (HeatBalance reference)

lifecycle.source: allow_pause: interruptible = true in config/jobs/transcription-whisper-large-v3.json; checkpointable: scenario value, a dictation is a short atomic unit, progress is kept on stop; not measured

input_mb_per_work_unit.source: TODO(source): audio data size per minute not in the repo; 0 = not modelled (not used by the engine)

state_mb.source: TODO(source): checkpoint size not in the repo; 0 = not modelled (not used by the engine)

placement_policy.source: Medical dictations contain patient data (docs/research/demand.md, private-practice physicians of Basel-Stadt); the allowlist keeps processing in Switzerland as the data-locality rule of docs/decisions/0013-job-data-locality.md. TODO(source): the customer contract clause that authorises the policy (decision 0013 requires it as source)

requests_per_day.source: docs/research/demand.md: 1,269 practising physicians in Basel-Stadt (415 primary-care physicians = 32.7 % of all, Jan 2024, https://grosserrat.bs.ch/dokumente/100406/000000406995.pdf, search snippet, accessed 2026-11-21) x 66.71 audio min per physician per month (median, Bax et al. 2011, Health Econ Rev 1:8, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3402968/, abstract, accessed 2026-11-21) x 12/365 months per day / 6.5 audio min per job = 428.2, rounded down (config/job-scenarios/transcription-basel.json)

volume_scale.source: scenario value: reference volume, no scaling

arrival_shape.source: Azure LLM inference trace 2024, service conv (data/raw/demand-traces/azure-llm-2024/SOURCE.md, https://github.com/Azure/AzurePublicDataset/blob/master/AzureLLMInferenceDataset2024.md, CC BY 4.0, retrieved 2026-11-21); labelled proxy: the shape of conversational LLM traffic stands in for medical dictation arrivals (data/raw/demand-traces/transcription-proxy/SOURCE.md)

client_site_share.source: scenario value, not sourced: every dictation originates at a client site (a practice); clients at the canton capitals, config/fleet/clients/canton-capitals.csv

chf_per_work_unit.source: derived: CHF 0.36 per audio hour / 60 min/h; 0.36 = Infomaniak Whisper V3 / kvant whisper-large-v3 (docs/research/compute-demand-traces.md section 3, 'Whisper transcription, per audio hour')
